Name: Balaam
Summary: Balaam, son of Beor, was a prophet from Pethor whom Balak king of Moab hired to curse Israel — but God put blessings in his mouth instead.
KeyStory: On the road to Moab, Balaam's donkey spoke to him and turned from the angel of the LORD; from the heights he blessed Israel four times and foretold a star out of Jacob.
RelatedPeople: Balak; Beor, Father of Balaam; Moses
LifeLesson: No payment can buy a curse on those God has blessed.
